applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 was answered and treats the issue as underdetermined rather than counting it as an unanswered witness.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: the phrase "If the judge says a verse was answered" — reading 1: the judge says the verse was answered, so it must not be counted; reading 2: the judge is only describing argument responses, but even then it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness
why: The judge does not count Matthew 1:20 as an unanswered witness; it says both sides answered the issue, and not counting an answered verse obeys K-G4.
